about: A page drawn round a 3D world as rings (parallax-readers r47, docs/page-as-3d-sky.md): no stills, numbers. Each scene is a page and the options a 3D scene gives core's ParallaxRings (front, far, foot, lift, scale, pageDegrees, fogStrength; fogStrength left out is the page's own). engines/rounds/reader's RingsRound writes core's numbers (./gradlew :rounds:rings -Pround=engines/rounds/rings -Pout=OUT: OUT/gdx/<id>.json); a 3D reader writes its own as OUT/<reader>/<id>.json, and tools/compare-rings.py OUT <reader> compares them.
